title: Azure Kubernetes Service Managed Cluster
description: Schema representing an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) managed cluster resource, based on the Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters resource type from the AKS REST API (api-version 2025-10-01).

id.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the managed cluster. Format: /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/{resourceName}

name.description: The name of the managed cluster resource.

location.description: The geo-location where the resource lives (e.g., eastus, westeurope).

kind.description: This is primarily used to expose different UI experiences in the portal for different kinds.

ManagedClusterSKU.description: The SKU of a managed cluster.

name.description: The name of a managed cluster SKU.

tier.description: The tier of a managed cluster SKU. If not specified, the default is Free.

principalId.description: The principal ID of the system-assigned identity associated with this resource.

tenantId.description: The tenant ID of the system-assigned identity associated with this resource.

type.description: The type of identity used for the managed cluster.

userAssignedIdentities.description: User-assigned identities associated with the resource. The keys must be ARM resource IDs.

resourceId.description: The resource ID of the user-assigned identity.

clientId.description: The client ID of the user-assigned identity.

objectId.description: The object ID of the user-assigned identity.

ExtendedLocation.description: The complex type of the extended location.

name.description: The name of the extended location.

type.description: The type of the extended location.

SystemData.description: Metadata pertaining to creation and last modification of the resource.

createdBy.description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC).

provisioningState.description: The current provisioning state of the managed cluster resource.

maxAgentPools.description: The maximum number of agent pools for the managed cluster.

kubernetesVersion.description: The version of Kubernetes specified by the user. Both patch version (e.g., 1.20.13) and minor version (e.g., 1.20) are supported. When a minor version is specified, the latest supported patch version is chosen automatically.

currentKubernetesVersion.description: The version of Kubernetes the Managed Cluster is running.

dnsPrefix.description: DNS prefix specified when creating the managed cluster. This cannot be updated once the Managed Cluster has been created.

fqdnSubdomain.description: FQDN subdomain specified when creating a private cluster with custom private DNS zone.

fqdn.description: The FQDN of the master pool.

privateFQDN.description: The FQDN of a private cluster.

azurePortalFQDN.description: The special FQDN used by the Azure Portal to access the Managed Cluster.

enableRBAC.description: Whether to enable Kubernetes Role-Based Access Control.

supportPlan.description: The support plan for the Managed Cluster.

disableLocalAccounts.description: If set to true, getting static credentials will be disabled for this cluster.

nodeResourceGroup.description: The name of the resource group containing agent pool nodes.

agentPoolProfiles.description: The agent pool properties for the managed cluster.

identityProfile.description: Identities associated with the cluster (e.g., kubeletidentity).

addonProfiles.description: The profile of managed cluster add-ons (e.g., azureKeyvaultSecretsProvider, httpApplicationRouting).

diskEncryptionSetID.description: The Resource ID of the disk encryption set to use for enabling encryption at rest.

ManagedClusterAgentPoolProfile.description: Profile for the container service agent pool.

name.description: The unique name of the agent pool profile in the context of the subscription and resource group.

count.description: Number of agents (VMs) to host docker containers. Allowed values must be in the range of 0 to 1000 (inclusive) for user pools and 1 to 1000 (inclusive) for system pools.

vmSize.description: The size of the agent VMs.

osDiskSizeGB.description: OS Disk Size in GB to be used to specify the disk size for every machine in the agent pool. Values of 0 apply the default OS disk size per vmSize.

osDiskType.description: The OS disk type to be used for machines in the agent pool.

kubeletDiskType.description: Determines the placement of emptyDir volumes, container runtime data root, and Kubelet ephemeral storage.

maxPods.description: The maximum number of pods that can run on a node.

osSKU.description: Specifies the OS SKU used by the agent pool.

mode.description: The mode of an agent pool. A cluster must have at least one System agent pool at all times.

orchestratorVersion.description: The version of Kubernetes running on the Agent Pool.

currentOrchestratorVersion.description: The version of Kubernetes the Agent Pool is running.

minCount.description: The minimum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

maxCount.description: The maximum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

scaleSetPriority.description: The Virtual Machine Scale Set priority.

scaleSetEvictionPolicy.description: The Virtual Machine Scale Set eviction policy.

spotMaxPrice.description: The maximum price (in US Dollars) for spot instances. -1 indicates default up-to on-demand pricing.

scaleDownMode.description: Describes how VMs are added to or removed from Agent Pools.

vnetSubnetID.description: The ID of the subnet which agent pool nodes and optionally pods will join on startup.

podSubnetID.description: The ID of the subnet which pods will join when launched.

enableNodePublicIP.description: Whether each node is allocated its own public IP.

nodePublicIPPrefixID.description: The public IP prefix ID for the nodes in the agent pool.

enableEncryptionAtHost.description: Whether to enable host-based OS and data drive encryption.

enableFIPS.description: Whether to use a FIPS-enabled OS.

nodeLabels.description: The node labels to be persisted across all nodes in agent pool.

nodeTaints.description: The taints added to new nodes during node pool create and scale.

tags.description: The tags to be persisted on the agent pool virtual machine scale set.

proximityPlacementGroupID.description: The ID for Proximity Placement Group.

availabilityZones.description: The list of Availability zones to use for nodes.

workloadRuntime.description: Determines the type of workload a node can run.

messageOfTheDay.description: A base64-encoded string which will be written to /etc/motd after decoding. Applicable only for Linux nodes.

ContainerServiceLinuxProfile.description: Profile for Linux VMs in the container service cluster.

adminUsername.description: The administrator username to use for Linux VMs.

ssh.description: The SSH configuration for Linux-based VMs running on Azure.

publicKeys.description: The list of SSH public keys used to authenticate with Linux-based VMs.

keyData.description: Certificate public key used to authenticate with VMs through SSH. The certificate must be in PEM format with or without headers.

ManagedClusterWindowsProfile.description: Profile for Windows VMs in the managed cluster.

adminUsername.description: The administrator username to use for Windows VMs.

adminPassword.description: The administrator password to use for Windows VMs.

licenseType.description: The license type to use for Windows VMs.

ManagedClusterServicePrincipalProfile.description: Information about a service principal identity for the cluster.

clientId.description: The ID for the service principal.

secret.description: The secret password associated with the service principal.

ManagedClusterAddonProfile.description: A Kubernetes add-on profile for a managed cluster.

enabled.description: Whether the add-on is enabled or not.

config.description: Key-value pairs for configuring an add-on.

ContainerServiceNetworkProfile.description: Profile of network configuration for the managed cluster.

networkPlugin.description: Network plugin used for building the Kubernetes network.

networkPluginMode.description: The mode the network plugin should use.

networkPolicy.description: Network policy used for building the Kubernetes network.

networkDataplane.description: Network dataplane used in the Kubernetes cluster.

podCidr.description: A CIDR notation IP range from which to assign pod IPs when kubenet is used.

serviceCidr.description: A CIDR notation IP range from which to assign service cluster IPs.

dnsServiceIP.description: An IP address assigned to the Kubernetes DNS service.

loadBalancerSku.description: The load balancer SKU for the managed cluster.

ipFamilies.description: IP families used to specify IP versions available to the cluster.

ManagedClusterAADProfile.description: Azure Active Directory configuration for integration with AKS.

enableAzureRBAC.description: Whether to enable Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorization.

adminGroupObjectIDs.description: The list of AAD group object IDs that will have admin role of the cluster.

tenantID.description: The AAD tenant ID to use for authentication.

ManagedClusterAutoScalerProfile.description: Parameters to be applied to the cluster-autoscaler when enabled.

balance-similar-node-groups.description: Detects similar node pools and balances the number of nodes between them.

expander.description: The expander to use when scaling up.

max-empty-bulk-delete.description: The maximum number of empty nodes that can be deleted at the same time.

max-graceful-termination-sec.description: Maximum number of seconds the cluster autoscaler waits for pod termination when trying to scale down a node.

max-node-provision-time.description: The maximum time the autoscaler waits for a node to be provisioned.

max-total-unready-percentage.description: Maximum percentage of unready nodes in the cluster.

scan-interval.description: How often the cluster is reevaluated for scale up or down.

scale-down-delay-after-add.description: How long after scale up that scale down evaluation resumes.

scale-down-delay-after-delete.description: How long after node deletion that scale down evaluation resumes.

scale-down-delay-after-failure.description: How long after scale down failure that scale down evaluation resumes.

scale-down-unneeded-time.description: How long a node should be unneeded before it is eligible for scale down.

scale-down-unready-time.description: How long an unready node should be unneeded before it is eligible for scale down.

scale-down-utilization-threshold.description: Node utilization level below which a node can be considered for scale down.

skip-nodes-with-local-storage.description: Whether the cluster autoscaler will skip deleting nodes with pods with local storage.

skip-nodes-with-system-pods.description: Whether the cluster autoscaler will skip deleting nodes with pods from kube-system.

ManagedClusterAutoUpgradeProfile.description: Auto upgrade profile for a managed cluster.

upgradeChannel.description: The upgrade channel for auto upgrade.

forceUpgrade.description: Whether to force upgrade the cluster, bypassing upgrade protections.

until.description: Until when the overrides are effective.

ManagedClusterAPIServerAccessProfile.description: Access profile for the managed cluster API server.

authorizedIPRanges.description: IP ranges authorized to access the Kubernetes API server.

enablePrivateCluster.description: Whether to create the cluster as a private cluster or not.

privateDNSZone.description: The private DNS zone mode for the cluster.

enablePrivateClusterPublicFQDN.description: Whether to create a public FQDN for private cluster or not.

disableRunCommand.description: Whether to disable run command for the cluster.

enableVnetIntegration.description: Whether to enable API server VNET integration for the cluster.

subnetId.description: The subnet to be used when API server VNET integration is enabled.

ManagedClusterSecurityProfile.description: Security profile for the container service cluster.

defender.description: Microsoft Defender settings for the security profile.

logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId.description: Resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace.

enabled.description: Whether to enable Defender threat detection.

workloadIdentity.description: Workload identity settings for the security profile.

imageCleaner.description: Image Cleaner settings for the security profile.

intervalHours.description: Image Cleaner scanning interval in hours.

ManagedClusterStorageProfile.description: Storage profile for the container service cluster.

enabled.description: Whether to enable AzureDisk CSI Driver.
Whether to enable AzureFile CSI Driver.
Whether to enable AzureBlob CSI Driver.

ManagedClusterIngressProfile.description: Ingress profile for the managed cluster.

enabled.description: Whether to enable Web App Routing.

dnsZoneResourceIds.description: Resource IDs of the DNS zones to associate with the Web App Routing addon.

ManagedClusterOIDCIssuerProfile.description: The OIDC issuer profile of the Managed Cluster.

issuerURL.description: The OIDC issuer URL of the Managed Cluster.

enabled.description: Whether the OIDC issuer is enabled.

ServiceMeshProfile.description: Service mesh profile for a managed cluster.

revisions.description: The list of revisions of the Istio control plane.

ManagedClusterWorkloadAutoScalerProfile.description: Workload Auto-scaler profile for the managed cluster.

controlledValues.description: Controls which resource value autoscaler acts on.

ManagedClusterNodeResourceGroupProfile.description: Node resource group lockdown profile for a managed cluster.

restrictionLevel.description: The restriction level applied to the cluster node resource group.

AgentPoolUpgradeSettings.description: Settings for upgrading an agent pool.

maxSurge.description: The maximum number or percentage of nodes that are surged during upgrade. This can be set to an integer (e.g., 5) or a percentage (e.g., 50%).

drainTimeoutInMinutes.description: The amount of time (in minutes) to wait on eviction of pods and graceful termination per node.

nodeSoakDurationInMinutes.description: The amount of time (in minutes) to wait after draining a node and before reimaging it.

PowerState.description: Describes the power state of the cluster or agent pool.

code.description: Tells whether the cluster is Running or Stopped.

CreationData.description: Data used when creating a target resource from a source resource.

sourceResourceId.description: The ARM ID of the source object to be used to create the target object.
